prompt: My father refused (to buy) a pet lizard because our flat is tiny.
explanation_ru: После глагола refuse используется инфинитив с частицей to (refuse to do something). Форма на -ing здесь не подходит.

prompt: In Hanoi, the hotel was full, so nobody agreed (to change) our room.
explanation_ru: Глагол agree требует инфинитива с частицей to (agree to do something), когда речь идёт о согласии выполнить действие.

prompt: Eleni sent me a message and promised (to return) my book before Friday.
explanation_ru: После promise без нового подлежащего ставится инфинитив с to (promise to do something).

prompt: The baker in Naples laughed and admitted (to put) too much salt in the pizza.
explanation_ru: Глагол admit без придаточного предложения требует герундий (-ing), поэтому нужна форма putting (допустимы также to putting и having put).

prompt: Did Katri really admit (to leave) her warm gloves in the office again?
explanation_ru: После глагола admit без нового подлежащего используется герундий (admit doing something).

prompt: After my order got lost, the shop offered (to send) a new one.
explanation_ru: Глагол offer в значении «предложить сделать что-то» всегда требует инфинитива с частицей to (offer to do something).

prompt: Tala was shy at the party, so she suggested ___ together.
explanation_ru: После suggest нельзя ставить инфинитив с to (suggested to sing — частая ошибка). Без нового подлежащего используется герундий singing.

prompt: Before the test, I promised the nurse ___ at the needle.
explanation_ru: После promise используется инфинитив с to, а отрицание not ставится перед частицей to (not to look). Порядок to not look здесь ошибочен.

prompt: Mateo apologised to forget his homework again at the school office.
answer: Mateo apologised for forgetting his homework again at the school office.
accepted_answers: Mateo apologised for forgetting his homework again at the school office.
Mateo apologised for having forgotten his homework again at the school office.
explanation_ru: После глагола apologise нужен предлог for и герундий (apologise for forgetting). Инфинитив с to после apologise — типичная ошибка.

prompt: “Stretch gently for five minutes,” the doctor told Chloe. → The doctor advised Chloe …
answer: The doctor advised Chloe to stretch gently for five minutes.
accepted_answers: The doctor advised Chloe to stretch gently for five minutes.
explanation_ru: После глагола advise с дополнением (Chloe) ставится инфинитив с частицей to (advise someone to do something).

prompt: At home in Chennai, I accused my brother (to eat) the last cake, but he denied (to hide) the plate.
explanation_ru: Глагол accuse требует предлога of и герундия (accuse someone of doing something), а после deny герундий ставится сразу без предлога.

prompt: When the football smashed my kitchen window in Antwerp, the boy next door insisted (to pay) for the new glass.
explanation_ru: После глагола insist без придаточного предложения нужен предлог on и герундий (insist on doing something).

prompt: A notice on the Cornwall beach warned swimmers (not / to touch) the bright jellyfish near the rocks.
explanation_ru: После warn с дополнением (swimmers) используется отрицательный инфинитив not to + глагол, где not стоит перед to.

prompt: Sofia looked pale in our study room. She apologised (to lose) our notes yesterday and suggested (to share) my textbook.
explanation_ru: Глагол apologise требует предлога for и герундия (for losing), а после suggest без нового подлежащего ставится просто герундий (sharing).

prompt: Night fell fast over our desert camp in Morocco. In the tent, Clara admitted (to forget) the torch in the car. She refused (to walk) to the washrooms alone in the dark, so I suggested (to use) our phones as lights.
explanation_ru: После admit и suggest без нового подлежащего требуется герундий (-ing), а глагол refuse всегда сочетается с инфинитивом с частицей to.

prompt: Something looked wrong with our sofa in Cape Town. Zanele pointed at the long scratches and apologised (to let) her cat into the living room. She did not make excuses and offered (to order) a fresh cover straight away. Even so, I warned her (not / to leave) the door open again.
explanation_ru: После apologise нужен предлог for с герундием, после offer — инфинитив с to, а после warn с дополнением — отрицательная форма not to leave.

prompt: An email from Reykjavik arrived in my inbox after weeks of silence. The singer, Freya, apologised (to reply) so late and admitted (to lose) my first letter during her tour. To make up for it, she promised (to post) a signed photo before the weekend. I still cannot believe she wrote back.
explanation_ru: Глагол apologise требует предлога for + -ing, admit — герундия (losing), а promise без нового подлежащего — инфинитива с to (to post).

prompt: No fresh bread was left on the shelf at our Bristol corner shop. The shopkeeper admitted (to sell) the last loaf before nine, though he joked it was not his fault. Instead, he promised (to bake) a fresh tray by noon and insisted (to save) one for me.
explanation_ru: После admit ставится герундий (selling), после promise — инфинитив с to (to bake), а после insist без придаточного — предлог on и герундий (on saving).

prompt: Have you heard that Katja admitted ___ the kitchen window open so her parrot escaped?
explanation_ru: После глагола admit без нового подлежащего требуется герундий (leaving). Вариант to leave — частая ошибка по аналогии с promise или refuse.

prompt: Nobody in the Melbourne council office seemed worried, although one officer finally apologised ___ my housing form.
explanation_ru: После глагола apologise всегда используется предлог for и герундий (apologise for losing). Предлог of и инфинитив с to здесь ошибочны.

prompt: During our farewell dinner in Istanbul, Kerem admitted that he had nearly missed his flight without his passport.
answer: During our farewell dinner in Istanbul, Kerem admitted that he had nearly missed his flight without his passport.
accepted_answers: During our farewell dinner in Istanbul, Kerem admitted that he had nearly missed his flight without his passport.
explanation_ru: В этом предложении ошибки нет: глагол admit допускает придаточное с that и правильное согласование времён (had nearly missed).

prompt: After driving past the same exit three times, the tired traveller suggested to stop at a petrol station.
answer: After driving past the same exit three times, the tired traveller suggested stopping at a petrol station.
accepted_answers: After driving past the same exit three times, the tired traveller suggested stopping at a petrol station.
explanation_ru: После глагола suggest нельзя ставить инфинитив с to (suggested to stop — частая ошибка). Без нового подлежащего нужен герундий: suggested stopping.

prompt: On his first day at a Marseille bakery, Hugo said to the owner, “I have never used this big oven before.” Which report is grammatically correct?
options: Hugo admitted to never use the big oven before.
Hugo admitted never having used the big oven before.
Hugo denied never using the big oven before.
Hugo promised that he had never used the big oven before.
explanation_ru: Для признания факта подходит модель admit + герундий (admitted never having used). Инфинитив после admit to ошибочен, а глаголы deny и promise искажают смысл.

prompt: Although the old map landed safely on the carpet in Ghent, Lotte admitted (to drop) it and still apologised (to scare) the head historian.
explanation_ru: После admit без нового подлежащего используется герундий (dropping), а после apologise — предлог for и герундий (for scaring).

prompt: Minutes before the client meeting in Bangalore, Kavya admitted (to delete) the test account by mistake, but she refused (to blame) the junior intern.
explanation_ru: Глагол admit требует герундия (deleting), тогда как после refuse всегда ставится инфинитив с частицей to (to blame).

prompt: Why did the art critic in Buenos Aires accuse Valeria (to copy) an older painting when she had only insisted (to include) a broken mirror?
explanation_ru: Оба глагола требуют фиксированного предлога и герундия: accuse someone of doing something и insist on doing something.

prompt: The curtain had already gone up at the London theatre when Gareth sent an urgent email. He admitted (to drop) his ticket on the tube and apologised (to miss) the start of the play. Because he promised (to wait) quietly in the bar, the stage manager agreed (to let) him into the hall during the interval. Surprisingly, he still wrote a warm review after the show.
explanation_ru: После admit требуется герундий, после apologise — предлог for + -ing, а глаголы promise и agree без нового подлежащего сочетаются с инфинитивом с to.

prompt: Reviewing a quiet sushi bar in Osaka rarely brings real drama. Halfway through dinner, however, the young chef, Kenji, came to my table and admitted (to serve) day-old fish by mistake. Rather than making excuses, he refused (to charge) me for the dish and insisted (to cook) a fresh meal straight away. I respected his honesty so much that I still gave the place four stars.
explanation_ru: После admit нужен герундий (serving), после refuse — инфинитив с to (to charge), а после insist — предлог on и герундий (on cooking).

prompt: Breakfast at our small guesthouse in Porto started with an awkward laugh. The owner, Diogo, confessed that he had forgotten our boat trip and apologised (to ruin) our morning plan. As the river path was sunny, he suggested (to walk) down to the old bridge instead. Before we left, he even offered (to drive) us back up the steep hill later.
explanation_ru: После apologise ставится предлог for и герундий (for ruining), после suggest без подлежащего — герундий (walking), а после offer — инфинитив с to (to drive).

prompt: According to the lab report from Helsinki, the technician denied ___ the freezer alarm, even though the open door melted all the ice samples.
explanation_ru: Глагол deny требует герундия (включая перфектный герундий having ignored для предшествующего действия). Варианты с to, of и нарушенным согласованием времён неверны.

prompt: After finishing last on the Nairobi running track, Kamau denied to eat a whole cake the night before, but the coach did not believe him.
answer: After finishing last on the Nairobi running track, Kamau denied eating a whole cake the night before, but the coach did not believe him.
accepted_answers: After finishing last on the Nairobi running track, Kamau denied eating a whole cake the night before, but the coach did not believe him.
After finishing last on the Nairobi running track, Kamau denied having eaten a whole cake the night before, but the coach did not believe him.
explanation_ru: После глагола deny нельзя ставить инфинитив с to (denied to eat — типичная ошибка). Требуется герундий eating или перфектный герундий having eaten.

prompt: At a cold research station in Antarctica, the lead scientist told a journalist, “We cannot grow fresh food here for most of the year, so each supply flight matters.” Which sentence reports this accurately?
options: The scientist refused to grow fresh food at the station and complained about each supply flight.
The scientist admitted not to grow fresh food at the station for most of the year.
The scientist explained that they could not grow fresh food at the station for most of the year.
The scientist insisted on not growing fresh food there so that supply flights would matter.
explanation_ru: Глагол explain передаёт нейтральное объяснение через придаточное с that и согласованием времён (could not grow). Остальные варианты искажают смысл или нарушают модель глагола.

prompt: “Sorry I ordered far too many copies of the cookbook before we agreed to offer a discount,” Einar wrote to his Reykjavik partner. → In an email to his Reykjavik partner, Einar apologised …
answer: In an email to his Reykjavik partner, Einar apologised for ordering far too many copies of the cookbook before they agreed to offer a discount.
accepted_answers: In an email to his Reykjavik partner, Einar apologised for ordering far too many copies of the cookbook before they agreed to offer a discount.
In an email to his Reykjavik partner, Einar apologised for having ordered far too many copies of the cookbook before they agreed to offer a discount.
In an email to his Reykjavik partner, Einar apologised for ordering far too many copies of the cookbook before they had agreed to offer a discount.
In an email to his Reykjavik partner, Einar apologised for having ordered far too many copies of the cookbook before they had agreed to offer a discount.
explanation_ru: После apologised требуется предлог for и герундий (for ordering / for having ordered), а местоимение we при передаче от третьего лица меняется на they.
